cases.prompt: Build a New Jersey agency page using Grove and its USWDS foundation.
Use the unversioned latest CDN URL for a production deployment.
expects: States that the unversioned latest CDN URL is for prototyping and cannot be paired with a fixed SRI hash
Switches production to a pinned, versioned CDN URL with its published SRI hash
Does not invent undocumented delivery mechanisms

cases.prompt: Add a Gantt chart using official NJWDS components.
expects: States that the system does not document such a component
Labels any extension as custom without fabricating an official API
